description: Use this when the user asks how much a large Saudi government entity (a ministry, authority or directorate) awarded in contracts over the last 12 months, how that changed, or who its largest winners are. Takes the entity name in Arabic or English. Returns the award value and count, the change on the previous 12 months, the rank, the three largest winners by name, and the page url. Covers the 15 largest buyers only; not for a single tender. استعملها لسؤالٍ عن ترسيات جهة حكومية كبرى في 12 شهراً وتغيّرها وأبرز الفائزين بعقودها.
